$doc: Neutral answer record for the exact papercusp-android-app@0.1.0 closure. Replace every answer; never add secret or signing values.

decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-android-app:android-app-purpos: Harbor Mobile is an offline-first field-log app; this record supplies every base and Android-shell decision for the first Android release.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:product-domain: Validated field-log entries, synchronization state transitions, serialization, and error taxonomy live in Rust; Compose owns presentation and Android lifecycle.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:rust-msrv: Rust 1.88 across the workspace and CI.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:license-and-reposi: Apache-2.0, Harbor Mobile contributors, and the final public repository URL replace all neutral starter metadata.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:design-token-sourc: design/mobile-tokens.json is the single source for product colors, spacing, radii, and typography; generated Kotlin and Swift outputs are drift-checked.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:optional-capabilit: Credentials and deep links are selected; push, analytics, crash reporting, camera, microphone, media playback, and local networking are not selected.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:runtime-configurat: Non-secret service endpoints are runtime inputs; device credentials use platform secure storage and no provider value enters this file.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-android-shell:android-identity: Namespace and application ID are dev.harbor.mobile, package sources live under dev/harbor/mobile, display name is Harbor Mobile, and release version comes from HARBOR_ANDROID_RELEASE_VERSION.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-android-shell:android-sdk-floo: Keep min SDK 24; compile and target SDK remain 36.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-android-shell:android-local-ne: No cleartext endpoint is required, including debug; debugCleartext remains false.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-android-shell:android-capabili: Declare INTERNET plus the selected credentials and deep-link seams only; add no unselected service, plugin, repository, or permission.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-android-shell:android-release: Use external HARBOR_ANDROID_RELEASE_* signing input names, publish APK and AAB together, bind the version input to atomic SHA-256 provenance, and keep every signing value outside the repository.
